function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The raw difference in response rates between arms is confounded by baseline severity, as treatment was assigned non-randomly and sicker patients were more likely to receive treatment. To estimate a valid treatment effect, I computed the difference in proportions within each severity stratum and then applied direct standardisation using the overall severity distribution as the reference. This adjusts for the imbalance and provides a valid estimate of the treatment effect under the assumption that severity is the only confounder."}
function.name: resolve_finding
